title: policy.json: trust
description: How the trust record is read (design parts 2.15 and 11.1). These settings change how a count is reported, never who decides what.

rubber_stamp_seconds.description: An answer that took the recommendation within this many seconds of the question being shown counts toward the area's rubber-stamp indicator. The indicator is a prompt to look, not a finding: a high share can also mean the recommendations are good.
